title: Plutonian Pebbles
description: Simulate stone transformations that split and multiply over 75 blinks.
writeup:
## Approach

Stones transform each blink: 0 becomes 1, even-digit numbers split in half, others multiply by 2024. The number of stones grows exponentially, so tracking individual stones is infeasible for 75 blinks.

## Key Insight

Stones with the same value transform identically. Use a `Counter` (value → count) to track how many stones have each value. Each blink updates the counter in O(unique values) time rather than O(total stones).

## Part 1 & 2

Apply 25 blinks for part 1, then 50 more (75 total) for part 2. The counter approach keeps memory manageable even as the stone count reaches trillions.
